show.description: Hazel was blackmailed with fake inappropriate photos to stop her wedding with Henry. Terrified, she lied that she was bored of him and walked away—secretly pregnant with his child. Years later, Henry runs into her and is stunned to see a little boy who looks just like him. what happens next?
